create_functional_model: create a functional version of a PyTorch nn.Module by extracting parameters into a callable
create_functional_model_with_buffers: create a functional nn.Module that takes both parameters and buffers as inputs
build_ensemble_models: build an ensemble of identical PyTorch models combined for vmap-based inference
